Detailed Description

The render model of a bot's deformable skin, skinned over the bot's links.

The model's vertices are posed by linear blend skinning: bone b carries a vertex from its rest pose to rootFromBone_b(current) * inverse(rootFromBoneRest[b]). Rest poses are those of the bot's links at the zero pose, the convention the skin is authored in; the model's own inverse-bind matrices are not used.
